source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document the date, time, and location of the audit.
3. List the auditors and any other officials present during the audit.
4. Record the industrial safety standards applicable to the facility.
5. Note any discrepancies from established safety procedures.
6. Use precise language to describe each safety issue found.
7. Specify the exact regulations or guidelines that were not adhered to.
8. Provide photographic evidence or detailed diagrams where applicable.
9. Record recommendations from the auditors for corrective actions.
10. Include a timeline for addressing the issues if provided.
11. Document any communication between management and auditors, including any explanations or justifications offered.
12. Reference other audit/failures if applicable for repeat offenses.
13. Include minutes from any meetings held in relation to the audit findings.
14. List any fines, notices, or legal action that resulted from the audit failures.
15. Record the next steps, including re-audit schedules, if applicable
